subject: Request: envelope encryption provenance & KMS access evidence for SIG
messages:
From: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@acmecloud.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@acmecloud.com>, ACME Security Team <security@acmecloud.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: envelope encryption provenance & KMS access evidence for SIG

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the demo last week. ACME's SIG intake team has a follow-up focused on envelope encryption and KMS custody. For our SIG assessment we need evidence to verify how data key (DEK) lifecycle is managed and how the KEK resides/protected in your HSM/KMS. Specifically could you provide:

- A mapping that shows how DEKs are encrypted (envelope encryption) vs which KEKs are stored in HSMs or cloud KMS (including key ids).
- Short explanation of who (roles) can perform KEK rotation and where rotation logs are retained.
- A recent HSM attestation (manufacturer statement / tamper evidence) or attestation reference and export-proof (if available).
- Sample key rotation log entries covering a 30-day window (redacted PII).
- Confirmation of in-transit encryption handling for DEKs (TLS + mutual TLS, cert chain details).

If you can provide these artifacts or point us to a Drive folder, we can close that section of the SIG. Goal is to include in the package by EOD Friday 6/25.

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Lowe
Security Program Manager, ACME Cloud
Samantha.Lowe@acmecloud.com

Attachments: none
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Request: envelope encryption provenance & KMS access evidence for SIG

Samantha —

Appreciate the clear list. We'll assemble a concise package and share a Drive link. Planned deliverables:

1) Envelope mapping spreadsheet (DEK -> KEK id, storage location, encryption algorithm).
2) Redacted rotation log CSV showing timestamp, key_id, actor (role:sys/ops), action (rotate/rollover), and checksum.
3) HSM attestation PDF (vendor-signed) and our internal HSM custody SOP excerpt.
4) Short note on TLS cert chain and mutual-TLS endpoints for inter-service DEK transport.

Evelyn and Vivek — can you pull the rotation log and HSM attestation? Laura please prep the envelope mapping sheet. I'll review and we can upload to the shared folder.

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

From: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>

Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: envelope encryption provenance & KMS access evidence for SIG

Jonas / team —

Pulling rotation logs now. Note on scope: Redwood uses envelope encryption for customer payloads where DEKs are ephemeral and encrypted under a KEK stored in our dedicated KMS-backed HSM cluster (HSM cluster id: rhd-hsm-1). The KEKs are non-exportable and protected by the vendor HSM (PKCS#11 interface).

Rotation model: automated scheduled rotation for KEKs every 90 days; emergency rotation processes exist and are audited. Rotation operations are gated by a quorum of two engineers + ops manager via our internal orchestration (no single-person rotation). Rotation events are logged to our immutable audit store (append-only log with retention 2 years, backed by WORM storage).

I'll attach a redacted CSV extract (first 30 days of May) and a pointer to the HSM attestation we received from the vendor last quarter. Also adding the excerpt from our KMS access matrix showing roles allowed for key administration.

Evelyn Hart
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: envelope encryption provenance & KMS access evidence for SIG

Samantha —

Thanks for the request. I've uploaded the artifacts to a shared folder and included a short narrative addressing the mapping and transport controls. Highlights: 

- Envelope mapping doc (envelope-mapping-dek-kek-202706.xlsx) shows schema: DEK_id, DEK_algorithm, KEK_id, KEK_location (rhd-hsm-1), wrapping_algorithm (RSA-OAEP-256) and last_rotation_timestamp.
- HSM attestation (vendor-signed) and our internal SOP excerpt are in the folder.
- Rotation log (redacted) is attached; note we redact user ids and present roles only (e.g., ops:rotation-bot, team:security).
- For in-transit protection: DEK transport between services is performed over mTLS with mutual validation against our internal CA. Certificate chain details and fingerprints are documented in the folder.

Shared links: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Envelope-KMS-Provenance-20270621 (artifacts and a short README).

If you need additional cryptographic proofs (HSM attestation chain or vendor certs), tell us what level/detail to include and we can escalate for the vendor-signed bundle.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
[attachment: envelope-mapping-dek-kek-202706.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@acmecloud.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@acmecloud.com>, ACME Security Team <security@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 17:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: envelope encryption provenance & KMS access evidence for SIG

Vivek / Jonas —

Received the folder and artifacts, thanks. We reviewed the envelope mapping and the rotation log sample — that addresses the SIG control references. A couple of quick follow-ups before we close the item:

1) For the HSM attestation PDF, can you provide the vendor-signed attestation chain (vendor cert + attestation) rather than the redacted copy? We can treat the bundle under NDA if required.
2) Please confirm whether the KEKs are stored in a customer-dedicated HSM partition or shared multi-tenant HSM instance. The SIG control requires clarity on tenancy for KEK protection.

If you can send those two items by EOD Monday we should be able to mark the SIG section complete. Appreciated —

Samantha
Samantha Lowe
Security Program Manager, ACME Cloud

Thread summary (internal use): Drive link uploaded, attachments included: kms_rotation_log_20270620.csv, hsm_attestation_2027-06.pdf, envelope-mapping-dek-kek-202706.xlsx.
